plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, if you bid less than your value, you risk losing the item to someone who values it less than you do. If you bid more than your value, you risk winning the item and losing money. Since this is round 1 of 1, there's no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value of $26.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks winning the auction but paying more than the item is worth to you. My value is $31, so I will bid that amount.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks overpaying. Therefore, I will bid my value of $24.
